start.topic: Perimeter of rectangles, squares and polygons
start.opening: Namaste Kabir, main Asha, aapki AI teacher hoon. Aaj perimeter seekhenge. Aapko rectangles ya squares mein se kaunsa shape pasand hai?

turns.reply: Board par dekho: Triangle ko teen sides wali shape samajhiye—teen lines milkar teen corners banati hain. Aap triangle ki teen sides gin kar boliye.

turns.line: board par rocket engine ka diagram banao
turns.reply: Rocket engine neeche se khula, gol metal chamber hota hai; rocket ke bottom mein laga hota hai. Ismein length aur breadth kaun si hain?
Board par dekho: Ab triangle par lautte hain: perimeter (parimap) nikalne ke liye teenon sides jodiye. Aap bataiye, kitni sides add hongi?
